version_records.action: GoGreen Home emergency amendment and two readoptions
version_records.legal_status: Second readoption operative as of 2026-10-01; regular rulemaking notice alone does not establish permanence
source_conflicts: Agency current-link label October 10 conflicts with signed initial approval October 20, 2025.
Agency first-readoption prose says April 3–July 2; signed approval specifies April 21–July 21, 2026.
OAL summary lists July 24; signed second-readoption notice specifies July 21, 2026.

First-readoption attached text says enrollment after October 1, 2025; initial and second-readoption signed packages say November 1, 2025. Preserve separate historical versions; do not infer identical text from agency no-modification summary.

version_records.action: GoGreen Business two emergency amendment chains and certificate 2026-0826-02C
version_records.legal_status: Multifamily second-readoption stated term extends through November 3, 2026. Disaster branch stated term ended September 29; permanent certificate disposition must be recovered before deciding current reconstruction provision.
version_records.remaining: OAL recent-actions table identifies certificate 2026-0826-02 but not disposition/date/final text. Agency page still shows proposed regular rulemaking. Do not infer approval or automatic lapse.
